note: Planned contracts with difficulty (easy, medium, hard), goals and acceptance criteria. core: true marks 0.1 critical-path work for the Development Department only (docs/departments.md). Shown when no GitHub issues carry the contract label yet. docs/contracts.md is generated from this file by tools/contracts_md.py.

contracts.title: Pin game build and set up Windows test rig
contracts.goal: Have one Windows machine that runs the exact game build we target, set up the same way every time.
acceptance: Game build 1.0.15.4 confirmed: exe file version and SHA-256 of mgsvtpp.exe recorded
Steam auto-update risk noted, and how to stay on the pinned build
Clean setup steps from install to main menu, reproducible by a second person
No game files or extracted assets in the repository

contracts.title: Proton test rig and setup guide
contracts.goal: Have a Linux machine with Proton that runs the same build, with a setup guide.
acceptance: Distro, Steam client build and Proton version recorded
Rig checklist in research/proton.md completed, results written down
A dummy dinput8.dll writes a log line under Proton with the documented launch option
Proton Experimental and latest GE-Proton both tried, differences noted

contracts.title: Survey public MGSV modding tools and docs
contracts.goal: Confirm on a rig the tool list from desk research, and find the community docs we can learn from.
acceptance: Each listed tool opened on build 1.0.15.4, with tool version and result
License of each tool recorded (reuse allowed, use only, or unknown)
Locations of mission scripts and player-related Lua listed (archive paths only, no content)

contracts.title: Document mod loading path (Windows)
contracts.goal: Know exactly how our native code gets into the game on Windows, alone and alongside IHHook.
acceptance: A test DLL loads as a dinput8 proxy and logs its start
A test plugin loads through IHHook's plugins folder (if the interface is suitable), or the reason it is not
Load order and timing relative to the game's Lua start recorded
Recommendation for ADR 0004 with evidence

contracts.title: Document mod loading path (Proton)
contracts.goal: The same loading path, confirmed under Proton.
acceptance: Both load paths from C04 tested under Proton
Any differences in timing, file paths or logging recorded
Exact launch options players need, ready to paste

contracts.title: Player and companion representation notes
contracts.goal: Understand how the player character and companions are created and controlled, and whether more controllable characters can exist.
acceptance: Lua and native entry points involved in player and buddy spawn listed (names and archive paths, no copied code)
Whether a second controllable character can exist in free roam: yes, no or unknown, with evidence
How FOB and MGO create additional players, as far as observable
Confidence marked for every claim

contracts.title: Mother Base roster notes
contracts.goal: Understand how Mother Base staff are stored and selected, so clients can join as roster staff.
acceptance: Where roster data lives at runtime and in the save, as far as observable
How a staff member is chosen for deployment and what defines their look and skills
Proposal for mapping client slots to roster staff

contracts.title: State inventory and sync priorities
contracts.goal: List every piece of state that must sync, ranked by cost and value.
acceptance: Table of state items: owner (host or client), update rate, size estimate, priority
Covers players, enemies, vehicles, world objects, mission flags, time and weather, plus the shared detection status and who has joined it (ADR 0012)
Bandwidth estimate per player at 16 players
Reviewed by the networking module owner

contracts.title: Spike: GameNetworkingSockets, Steam Messages vs Sockets
contracts.goal: Prove the transport outside the game: open-source GameNetworkingSockets and Steam networking side by side.
acceptance: Builds on Windows and Linux from a clean checkout with written steps
Reliable and unreliable messages between two machines on both paths
Messages vs Sockets compared: API fit, NAT behavior, latency
Confirms or overturns the proposed ADR 0018 (Sockets) for ADR 0003

contracts.title: Simulate 16 clients and measure bandwidth
contracts.goal: Measure what 16 clients cost.
acceptance: Simulator runs 1 host and 15 clients on one machine
Bandwidth and CPU at 2, 4, 8 and 16 players, with the state model from C08
Results under the bad-network profiles from C12

contracts.title: Mock Steam DLL for one-PC testing
contracts.goal: Test multiplayer on one PC without real Steam accounts.
acceptance: Mock DLL answers the Steam calls our code uses, written from public docs only
Two game instances can talk through it on one machine
Clear warning that it is for development only, never shipped

contracts.title: Bad-network test profiles (clumsy, tc netem)
contracts.goal: Repeatable bad-network conditions for testing.
acceptance: Profiles for good, average and bad connections (latency, jitter, loss)
Scripts for clumsy (Windows) and tc netem (Linux)
One-line usage in research/test-harness.md

contracts.title: Summarize networking playbook in our own words
contracts.goal: Summarize the networking playbook in our own words.
acceptance: Done. Kept here as an example of a finished small contract

contracts.title: Draft Steam App ID and rights position
contracts.goal: A written position on using MGSV's Steam App ID, our license and donations.
acceptance: Position on App ID 287700 with sources, and the question drafted for Valve support
License recommendation matched to ADR 0005
Donation policy matched to the funding stance
Marked clearly as not legal advice

contracts.title: Publish Phase 1 contracts as GitHub issues
contracts.goal: Move the planned contracts onto GitHub so people can claim them.
acceptance: One issue per contract with goal, deliverable and acceptance checklist
Labels contract, module:<name> and size:<S/M/L> set
Dependencies linked by issue number
The website board switches to live issues

contracts.title: Lobby app wireframes
contracts.goal: Wireframes for the lobby and session screens.
acceptance: Host flow: create session, invite, start
Player flow: join, gear selection, deploy
Fits ADR 0008 stage 1 (invite links)
Works with keyboard and gamepad

contracts.title: Mod API draft v0
contracts.goal: First draft of the API other mods use to work with Joint Operations.
acceptance: Events, sync hooks and versioning rules drafted
Two example use cases written out
Compatibility stance on Infinite Heaven

contracts.title: Join and leave feasibility notes
contracts.goal: Can players join and leave mid-session in a way that fits the game world?
acceptance: In-game arrival and departure mechanisms listed (helicopter, Fulton, others)
Feasibility for mid-mission join and leave, with known unknowns
What happens to a leaving client's staff member

contracts.title: Engine session spike: can 3+ players join?
contracts.goal: Find out whether the engine's own multiplayer layer can run a free-roam session with three or more players. This decides ADR 0002.
acceptance: Time-boxed to two weeks, with a result either way
Whether a session with 3+ players starts: yes, no or partly, with logs
What blocks it, if anything
No Konami online services contacted at any point

contracts.title: Steam interfaces from inside the game (rig test)
contracts.goal: Run the R13 rig test: confirm that current Steam networking interfaces are reachable from inside the game on Windows and Proton.
acceptance: All six test steps in the note run on Windows and Proton
Pass or fail recorded per step, with Steam client and Proton versions
Which callback approach works
ADR 0003 updated with the result

contracts.title: Join links: Steam lobby links and launch arguments
contracts.goal: Run the R14 rig tests for joining from a website.
acceptance: Whether launch arguments reach the game through Konami's launcher
steam:// and a dummy jointops:// link tested from native and Flatpak browsers on Linux
Results feed ADR 0008

contracts.title: Website accessibility pass
contracts.goal: Make every page of the website usable by keyboard and screen reader, with readable contrast.
contracts.deliverable: Pull request with fixes, and a short report in research/accessibility.md
acceptance: Every page and control reachable and usable with the keyboard alone
Text contrast meets WCAG AA on all pages
Tested with one screen reader (NVDA, Orca or VoiceOver); findings written down
No visual regressions in the browser smoke test

contracts.title: HUD design for the detection status
contracts.goal: Design how each player sees the one shared detection status and whether they are part of it.
contracts.deliverable: Mockups (vector or hand-built, no generative AI art) and notes in docs/design/alert-hud.md
acceptance: Shows Hidden, Searched for and Detected, and which players are in the alert
Fits the game's own HUD style without copying Konami assets
Readable at 1080p and on Steam Deck
Reviewed against ADR 0012

contracts.title: Session Browser against a mock registry
contracts.goal: Make the website's Session Browser read sessions from a mock of the planned session registry API.
contracts.deliverable: A mock registry JSON and the Session Browser changes, behind the existing data hook
acceptance: Mock follows the registry sketch in ADR 0008
Search, region filter, sorting and Hide full work on mock data
Empty and error states stay calm and clear
Smoke test passes in all three engines
